content:
maya: Heads up — we're flipping the new runtime-performance dashboard tomorrow AM. Need to lock alert thresholds + oncall routing before canary. Proposed (prod): p95 latency > 250ms, error rate > 0.5% sustained 5m, SLO burn > 1.5x over 15m. Ping @alex @sam @jin for routing/telemetry/UX input.

alex: Can we add a "degraded" tier that only pages infra after a longer sustained window (e.g., 30m)? Otherwise platform team should get first look. :thinking:

sam: Quick note on metrics: token_p95 currently has host + model_id tags. That causes a ton of noise. Recommend alerting on service-level aggregated p95 (by region) to start, and then add model buckets if we see systemic issues. Also add sampling for request logs.

jin: From console/rollout UX: we need a "silence window" toggle for canaries and clear runbook links on each alert card. Also the rollouts page should show which alerts are silenced during canary.

maya: Agreed on aggregate by default. Alex, can you propose exact per-env thresholds and routing? staging vs prod should differ.

alex: Draft config below — open to bikeshedding:

```
alerts:
  - name: runtime_p95_latency
    env: prod
    threshold_ms: 250
    for: 5m
    severity: high
    route: platform_oncall
    fallback: runtime_oncall
  - name: runtime_error_rate
    env: prod
    threshold_pct: 0.5
    for: 5m
    severity: high
    route: platform_oncall
    escalation: runtime_oncall after 10m
  - name: slo_burn_rate
    env: prod
    burn_threshold: 1.5
    window: 15m
    severity: critical
    route: oncall_escalation
```

sam: One concern: p95 varies a lot by model size. Small models typically p95 ~180ms, large (8B+) ~350ms. If we use a single 250ms cutoff we may get false positives for large models. Can we bucket into small/large?

maya: That's a fair point. Maybe two buckets: "small/medium" and "large". Keep it limited to avoid metric explosion.

alex: Ok — compromise: add model_class label and two threshold sets. I'll update the draft.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Created alerting config PR #482 -> https://git.internal/r/infra/alerts/482 :rocket:

jin: Please include runbook links in the PR: https://wiki/redwood/runbooks/runtime_p95 and add a link to the console card.

sam: Also add a metric tag `prefill_cache=true` so we don't alert on prefill/spike artifacts. And please ensure we roll up to region/service level in the alert query to reduce noise.

maya: Action items: alex update PR with model buckets + escalation timings; jin add runbook link + console silence toggle; sam add prefilling tag and reduce cardinality. Target: merge by EOD so canary flip tomorrow. @alex @jin @sam

alex: :thumbsup: will update by noon.

sam: I can add the prefilling tag in the next deploy at 11:30.

maya: One more on routing: who gets paged at 2AM for critical SLO burns? Propose critical -> infra-primary -> infra-secondary -> platform-lead. Noncritical -> platform-primary -> platform-secondary.

alex: Routing matrix I'll include in the PR. Quick sketch: critical -> infra-primary -> infra-secondary -> oncall-escalation -> platform-lead. noncritical -> platform-primary -> platform-secondary -> infra-oncall fallback.

maya: Perfect. I'll review the PR when it's updated. Thanks all. :pray:
